profile.vacancy_text: Junior Business Analyst, Northgate Advisory (Warsaw). You will support client projects in operations and pricing: collect and clean data, build models in Excel and Power BI, prepare slides for steering committees and present findings to client teams. We expect a degree in economics or business, strong analytical thinking, fluent English and attention to detail. We offer mentoring and a hybrid schedule.
